message: posterior_predict(newdata =) is not supported for this model: its draws are structured (a hidden state sequence, a group-level latent class, or a correlated residual) and that structure indexes the rows the model was fitted on. Drop newdata to predict those rows

cens()/trunc() need a family with a CDF (currently: gaussian, lognormal, poisson, exponential, weibull, inverse.gaussian, cox). The list is not closed: a family supplies one through the lcdf argument of frmtmb_family(), and a family that only ever sees RIGHT censoring may supply the log survivor fun

ar(): trunc() cannot be combined with a residual correlation term. The likelihood is a joint density over each group, so it no longer factorizes into per-row contributions that a frequency weight could repeat, a censoring indicator could replace with a tail probability, a truncation bound could reno
simulate(re_formula =) is not supported for an hmm() fit: the state path is drawn at the random-effect modes. Drop re_formula to simulate conditionally on them
simulate(censored = TRUE) is not supported for an hmm() fit, because cens() is refused on an hmm() response
